data_policy.PantheonPlus: full STAT+SYS covariance; selection (zHD>0.01) OR calibrator; M_B analytically profiled and counted
data_policy.DESI_DR2: 13 primary BAO observables with committed verified 13x13 covariance and repo-local order binding
data_policy.cosmic_chronometers: only source labels beginning CC_ and excluding BAO
data_policy.excluded: f_sigma8 and CMB until G8/G9 perturbation/early-time closure

ready_when: all six mandatory models are present
all G4 input hashes are present and 64-hex
executor and contracts are locally hash-bound
no growth/CMB proxy has been silently introduced
stop_when: data/covariance/selection differs between models without declared domain reason
boundary: READY_G5_CANONICAL_BACKGROUND_LIKELIHOOD != Bayesian evidence != perturbation closure != physical confirmation
